name: satisfy-assets
description: Frontend dependencies of Satisfy. They are copied to public/ and served from there, so the UI never loads files from a CDN.

scripts.assets: mkdir -p public/css public/fonts && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css.map public/css/ && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/recursive/files/recursive-latin-mono-normal.woff2 public/fonts/recursive.woff2 && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/recursive/LICENSE public/fonts/recursive-OFL.txt
